label: Data Machine · A100 slices
goodFor: Smaller inference and CUDA experiments that fit within an allocated 10 GB GPU slice.
limitations: A slice receives only part of a physical A100’s compute and memory. Do not assume full-card performance, full-card NVLink behavior, or automatic pooling of slices.
note: Data Machine account access required. Named-node resource table lists nal-007 with seven 10 GB slices per physical GPU; surrounding prose conflicts on the number of partitioned nodes. Verify the live allocation.
